name: Parallel-current attraction and repulsion
summary: Ampère showed in 1820 that two parallel wires carrying electric current pull together when the currents run the same way and push apart when they are opposed.
description: Two parallel straight conductor sections, one counterweighted and movable, carry currents from two voltaic piles; same-direction currents attract and opposite-direction currents repel.
